name: agentops-os
description: AgentOps OS - gouvernance, orchestration, audit et evaluation pour agents de codage sous supervision humaine.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: npm --workspace @agentops/shared run build && npm --workspace @agentops/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: npm --workspace @agentops/shared run build && npm --workspace @agentops/web run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm --workspace @agentops/shared run build && npm --workspace @agentops/api run build && npm --workspace @agentops/web run build
scripts.test: npm run build:core && npm run test:core && npm --workspace @agentops/shared run build && npm --workspace @agentops/api run test
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm --workspace @agentops/api run start" "npm --workspace @agentops/web run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1"
